occupations.title: Customer Service Representatives
occupations.rationale: Help Scout is a help desk software that consolidates customer communications from email, SMS, social, chat, and voice into a single inbox to help teams resolve conversations faster [D:Help Scout:landing:1, D:Help Scout:landing:2].

occupations.title: Computer User Support Specialists
occupations.rationale: As a help desk software used by SaaS companies, computer user support specialists would use Help Scout to manage and resolve technical support conversations with users [D:Help Scout:landing:1, D:Help Scout:landing:7].

occupations.title: First-Line Supervisors of Office and Administrative Support Workers
occupations.rationale: These supervisors would use Help Scout's productivity reports to manage staffing and scheduling challenges for the customer service teams they oversee [D:Help Scout:landing:6].
